title: Facet standalone engine JSON contract version 1
$comment: Normative language-neutral source. Inputs default absent schemaVersion to v1; unknown versions fail. Profile array members and nested records inherit their envelope version.

retainedCommand.$comment: Private persisted host actions only. Execution always validates the narrower public mutation contract.

retainedMutation.$comment: Private retained drafts from earlier clients. Never use this schema to authorize new commands.

payloadInfo.$comment: Metadata only. id is at most 256 UTF-8 bytes without controls. Callers additionally enforce written<=size and sealed=>written==size; these relational invariants are validated by the runtime's durable image reader.

engineError.$comment: Sanitized error projection. HostContract is permanent callback corruption/ownership/range failure. Busy preserves immutable intent for retry; neither means a rejected mutation may be discarded.
